title: Sprint 1: Architecture, SQLite Configuration & Data Models
description: Establish the foundational architecture of the FastAPI application. Configure the SQLite database with SQLAlchemy ORM, implement the health check endpoint, and design the User and Task relational models.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 - FastAPI Application Setup & Health Check API
tickets.description:
Set up the core FastAPI application in `main.py` and SQLite database configuration in `app/database.py`.

### Specifications
1. In `app/database.py`, initialize SQLAlchemy `engine` for SQLite (`sqlite:///./todo.db`), `SessionLocal`, declarative `Base`, and `get_db()` dependency generator.
2. In `main.py`, instantiate `FastAPI(title="FastAPI Todo REST API")` and add `CORSMiddleware`.
3. Create all tables on startup via `Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)`.
4. Implement `GET /api/health` returning `{"status": "healthy", "service": "fastapi-todo-api"}` with HTTP 200.
learning_objectives: Set up SQLAlchemy ORM with SQLite database engine.
Implement health check endpoint for monitoring.

tasks.title: Initialize FastAPI app instance with CORS middleware in main.py
Configure SQLite engine, SessionLocal, Base, and get_db in app/database.py

common_mistakes: Forgetting check_same_thread=False for SQLite in multithreaded environments.
Not exporting app instance in main.py.

solution.main.py:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from app.database import engine, Base
from app.routers import auth, tasks

if engine is not None and Base is not None:
    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

app = FastAPI(
    title="FastAPI Todo REST API",
    description="A production-grade Todo REST API built with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and SQLite.",
    version="1.0.0",
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

@app.get("/api/health", tags=["Health"])
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "fastapi-todo-api"}

app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])
app.include_router(tasks.router, prefix="/api/tasks", tags=["Tasks"])
solution.app/database.py:
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker

DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./todo.db"

engine = create_engine(
    DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False}
)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)

Base = declarative_base()

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

tickets.title: Ticket 2 - User Model & Secure Password Hashing
tickets.description:
Create the `User` model in `app/models.py` using SQLAlchemy Declarative Base. Implement password hashing and verification in `app/utils/security.py`.

### Model Specifications: `users` Table
- `id`: Integer, primary key, indexed.
- `username`: String (max 80), unique, non-nullable, indexed.
- `email`: String (max 120), unique, non-nullable, indexed.
- `password_hash`: String (max 255), non-nullable.
- `created_at`: DateTime, defaults to `datetime.utcnow`.

### Security Helpers (`app/utils/security.py`)
- `hash_password(password: str) -> str`: Hashes plain text password securely.
- `verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool`: Verifies plain text against stored hash.
learning_objectives: Create SQLAlchemy ORM models with Column, Integer, and String.
Enforce unique and non-nullable column constraints.
Implement secure password hashing using standard PBKDF2/cryptography.

from datetime import datetime

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    username = Column(String(80), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    email = Column(String(120), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    password_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

tickets.title: Ticket 3 - Task Model with User Relationship & Cascade Deletion
tickets.description:
Implement the `Task` model in `app/models.py` and configure the one-to-many relationship with `User`.

### Model Specifications: `tasks` Table
- `id`: Integer, primary key, indexed.
- `user_id`: Integer, ForeignKey referencing `users.id` with `ondelete='CASCADE'`, non-nullable.
- `title`: String (max 200), non-nullable.
- `description`: Text, nullable.
- `is_completed`: Boolean, default `False`, non-nullable.
- `created_at`: DateTime, defaults to `datetime.utcnow`.
- `updated_at`: DateTime, defaults to `datetime.utcnow`, updates on modification.

### Relationship
- `User.tasks`: One-to-many relationship linking to `Task`, with cascade delete orphan rule.
- `Task.owner`: Back-populates to `User`.
learning_objectives: Model relational foreign keys in SQLAlchemy.
Set up cascade delete rules to ensure database integrity.

tasks.title: Define Task model with foreign key pointing to users.id
Configure is_completed default value False and timestamp fields
Configure relationship and cascade delete between User and Task

hints: In User model: `tasks = relationship('Task', back_populates='owner', cascade='all, delete-orphan')`.

solution.app/models.py:
from datetime import datetime
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from app.database import Base

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    username = Column(String(80), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    email = Column(String(120), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    password_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)

    tasks = relationship("Task", back_populates="owner", cascade="all, delete-orphan")

class Task(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False)
    title = Column(String(200), nullable=False)
    description = Column(Text, nullable=True)
    is_completed = Column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)

    owner = relationship("User", back_populates="tasks")
